content.text: After endovascular or surg revasc: ↓dose rivaroxaban 2.5 mg BID + low-dose ASA.
ALI: testing for a CV cause of thromboembolism can be useful; AF → anticoagulate per AF risk (CHA2DS2-VASc ≥2 men / ≥3 women).
